description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCategoryController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for handling HTTP requests related to displaying product categories and associated data in an e-commerce web application. It manages category display, product listing, filtering, and related operations such as fetching categories and products via REST endpoints.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing display and interaction logic for product categories in an e-commerce platform, including category details, product listings, and filtering endpoints.

methods.name: displayCategoryWithReference
methods.description: Handles requests for a category page with a reference parameter, delegating to the core displayCategory method.

methods.name: displayCategoryNoReference
methods.description: Handles requests for a category page without additional references, delegating to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Core method that retrieves category information, constructs breadcrumbs, fetches subcategories and manufacturers, and prepares the view for the category page.

methods.name: getManufacturersByProductAndCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with products in specified categories, utilizing caching for optimization.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches manufacturer details for a list of manufacturer IDs.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Counts the number of products in each subcategory for display purposes.

methods.name: getSubCategories
methods.description: Gets subcategory proxies with product counts for display under a category.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: REST endpoint that returns all categories for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: REST endpoint to retrieve products belonging to a specified category, with optional filtering.

methods.name: getProducts (paging version)
methods.description: Provides paged products for a category, supporting start and max parameters.

methods.name: getProductsFilteredByType
methods.description: Retrieves filtered paged products based on filter type and value, such as brand.

methods.name: getProducts (internal logic)
methods.description: Executes the actual product retrieval logic based on parameters, filters, and pagination.
